purpose: Prevent SALES_TEXTURED from silently inventing room/material geometry while preserving forward progress.

conditional_requirements.ANNOTATION: if present, source trace or user confirmation required
conditional_requirements.FURNITURE: verified semantic mask OR explicitly presentation-only and allowed by user intent
conditional_requirements.LANDSCAPE: optional presentation layer subject to project constraints

fallback.reason: Keep work moving without converting unknown semantics into false geometry.
fallback.rule: Fallback is automatic; it does not ask the user to debug the engine.

unlock_rule: A later verified CAD layer rule, explicit source semantic, or user-confirmed mask may unlock SALES_TEXTURED without recomputing L0/L1.
